title: Sam Altman just revealed AGI is 2 years away — here is what that means

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: If AGI arrives in two years, what immediate changes should we expect in technology and society?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Current systems use transformer models and reinforcement learning — we're close but not there yet. Scaling and alignment remain major hurdles.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A sudden AGI could disrupt labor, privacy, and power structures — we need global governance frameworks to prevent misuse.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Engineers are focusing on alignment research, transparency protocols, and safety layers to ensure AGI remains beneficial and controllable.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: With proper oversight, AGI could solve climate change, cure diseases, and democratize knowledge — the future is in our hands.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The next two years will test our readiness — the path to AGI is as much about ethics as it is about engineering.

video_cue: A sleek, minimalist interface displaying a timeline of AI milestones leading up to a glowing "AGI Achieved" marker.
